minutes.summary: The meeting was dominated by public comment and committee discussion on school masking for the fall, after the superintendent recommended universal indoor masking and a Test and Stay program. what_happened.line: The committee made a motion to honor the superintendent's universal indoor masking and Test and Stay recommendations in total; the vote count was not audible.
The committee took up an extended day enrollment cap after afternoon registrations rose above prior-year levels; the vote outcome was not audible.
The committee heard two small budget transfers, one of them to replace a floor scrubber at Turkey Hill from the electricity line.
New positions were presented: a high school special education teacher funded by new grant money, and a community schools director with no local budget impact.
Facility use policy 1202 was sent back for rework, and a joint meeting with the finance committee on Chapter 70 was targeted for October 28.

why_it_matters: The masking and Test and Stay decision sets the fall school-day rules for students and families, and the captions do not record how the committee voted.
Grant-funded and revolving-account positions, plus American Rescue money that must be spent by the end of 2024, affect how much of school staffing falls on the local budget and taxes.
